notes.title: Patch 003
notes.notes:
Notes on the patch ::  

 Added voice acting in English.
 The red fire of the Boss Poison Spider no longer kills.
 Fixed logic at the level.

notes.title: Patch 002
notes.notes:
Patch notes::

 Added English translation of text.
 Fixed bugs with game settings.
 Fixed bug with run button.
 Changes were made to craft widget (show how many resources the player has).
 left alt or left ctrl - activates dodge.
 Fixed minor bugs in the game (Collisions, textures, NPC behavior or assistant behavior)
 Added hints for quickly finding door opening levers.

notes.title: Patch 001
notes.notes:
Patch notes::

 Changes have been made to the "double jump" skill.
